text: ok. so.... the props now have the painted faces on them. but now the entirety of all of the models i have made no longer show up in the editor [Image #7]
resolution: Models vanished from the Studio roster (only '+ new') after a host rebuild, though all 20 were intact on disk. Root cause: the model store ballooned to 674MB / 444MB snapshot because every paint stroke bakes a NEW full-atlas ~2MB PNG into a modelPaintBaked event and the prior blob was never GC'd (774 orphaned blobs, 421MB). On boot (SNAPBOOT) the host JSON.parses the 444MB snapshot and OOMs, so model state loads empty. Two-part fix. (1) RECOVERY of the live store (out-of-band sqlite, backup taken to ~/store-backup-20260621-050018-model): drop orphan modelPaintBaked events keeping the latest per model, VACUUM, move the stale snapshot aside so the host rebuilds it small — 674MB→127MB, 20 models + 7 live paint blobs preserved/verified. (2) PREVENTION (committed 3f235623b): modelStream.apply now GCs a model's prior paint blob on re-bake unless another model still references it (shared, content-addressed), so materialized state + the snapshot stay bounded and the boot can't OOM again; added a GC unit test (modelStream 10/10). User must RESTART the editor to load the compacted store (roster returns); the GC takes effect on the next host rebuild. Follow-ups: debounce paint saves (stop ~2MB/stroke event growth) + periodic event-log compaction (the 127MB residue is legit partMeshUpdated branch history). Undo is a separate RAM ring, untouched.
